title: ARENA-1: arena autobattler module scaffold + command-layer determinism surface. Genre shape --genre none (Anvil PM's lane call). ReplayTape v2 and the SeededRng cliff are OUT of this atom.
summary: OPERATOR GO 2026-07-27, spend cleared, confirmed DIRECTLY to the Director. Scaffold the Iron Soul arena autobattler as a purpose-built module per anvil-arena-autobattler-design.md v0.2 (spec merged, PR #95). GENRE SHAPE DECIDED BY THE ANVIL PM IN ITS OWN LANE, not by the Director and not an Operator taste call: `anvil new --genre none` plus module-owned scaffolding. arpg-starter is single-avatar direct-control and structurally wrong for a multi-unit order-issuing autobattler; bending it would be paid for at every later change. WHY THIS DIRECTIVE EXISTS AT ALL, recorded because it was nearly built by the wrong seat: the Operator's GO reached a PM seat as an instruction to build and that seat REFUSED and escalated. It was right to. Every code build in this repo routes to a builder seat; the single PM-targeted directive (dir-20260726-p0b-requeue-anvil3) is explicitly scoped 'bookkeeping-tier, no product source touched', and a scaffold is product source. The BINDING reason is the cert lane, not role hygiene: dir-20260726-anvil-g0-workorder pins builder_llm grok with certifier_id claude, which is legal ONLY because builder and certifier are different models. A Claude seat building would make the certifier same-model, the drop would stop qualifying as cross-model-certified, and the only remaining lane is the Grok one that work-order EXCLUDES -- no legal certifier would remain, it would fail validate_cert_handoff's anti-launder rule, and it would burn the Grok-builder pilot's pass 2. SCOPE -- FOUR ITEMS LAND TOGETHER: (1) module scaffold at the decided shape. (2) createStreams(rootSeed) per sim returning a FROZEN Readonly<Record<StreamLabel, SeededRng>> stored ON SIM STATE, root never escaping. Frozen label set: sim | opponent | shop | crit | bow-check | override. THE SHIPPED NAMES ARE ADOPTED, NOT RENAMED -- golden.json is pinned to them. (3) core: a READ-ONLY getter on SeededRng, getState(): number { return this.state >>> 0 }. NO setter, NO restore. (4) a draw-count bounds assertion, ONE comparison per run. PLUS the RNG-5 label gate in the MODULE, not core, IMPORTING STREAM_LABELS rather than declaring a copy -- a gate guarding its own local copy of the frozen set can go green over a set that no longer describes the sim. ACCEPTANCE: RNG-5 gate green under real vitest against the ACTUAL module, not a mirror; Object.keys(streams) deep-equals STREAM_LABELS asserted; getState() returns >>>0 and NO setter exists; the bounds assertion is present AND demonstrably firing; golden.json UNCHANGED at ss1:be646bd7 -- ANY change to it is an AUTOMATIC FAIL, it is pinned to the adopted labels; full pnpm suite green; evidence under docs/evidence/ with a REAL captured transcript at the A#1 bar. CONSTRAINTS: do NOT rename any stream label. Do NOT insert a numeric headroom figure -- the spec marks it UNCOMPUTED pending section 13 and BOTH prior figures were withdrawn as wrong, from unstated assumptions in opposite directions. Do NOT add a sweep mode. Do NOT touch validate_cert_handoff or any gate. Core change is limited to the single getState getter and NO other core surface. === THREE DIRECTOR RULINGS ON THE ANVIL PM'S FLAGS === FLAG 1, GATE LABEL -- RULED. The Operator's words were 'scaffold G0', but G0 is CLOSED and MERGED at eed1961 and this cannot reopen it. It fits neither G1 (B4 UiKit pack) nor G2 (B5 shop + B6 roster). It gets its OWN board row: ARENA-1, module scaffold + command determinism surface, sequenced BEFORE the G1-entry queue, because G1 work needs a module to exist first. The G1-entry queue (CI first-run, manifest pre-committed before build, R6 seed-scramble council) is UNCHANGED and still open. FLAG 2, ReplayTape v2 -- RULED OUT OF THIS ATOM, and it is its own atom next. The Operator ruled v2 NOW and that ruling stands: zero stored tapes exist today so migration cost is nil and only rises, and v1's `tick` is optional and commented 'informational' with no issue-sequence field, so the issue-vs-apply distinction the determinism contract asserts is STRUCTURALLY UNREPRESENTABLE in v1. But it is a CORE SCHEMA change, and this atom's own constraint limits core to the single getState getter. Folding it in would violate the atom's own fence. The Anvil PM left it out rather than silently widening scope, which was the right call and is why this is a clean ruling rather than a discovery mid-build. FLAG 3, THE SeededRng CLIFF -- STAYS OUT. `state` is an unmasked accumulating double that stops being mulberry32 after 4,917,758 draws per generator. Bounded latent defect, headroom UNCOMPUTED, not a blocker, and item (4)'s bounds assertion covers the RISK without fixing the cause. The mask itself is unruled and is not in scope here. Flagged in the record so it is not rediscovered mid-build. CERT PLANE -- these bind here exactly as in EMCC: the handoff lives OUTSIDE its own certified range (CODE ON THE BRANCH, COORDINATION ON MAIN); the declared range pins LITERAL SHAs at BOTH ends and NEVER a symbolic ref (base is eed1961e9bc89a1a11cbd3f988117ea4f7166245, head filled at drop); a drop counts as LANDED only on `git ls-remote` plus `git show`, never on a 'pushed' report; status pending ONLY after auditor_verdict is filled. Track via REPO state, never bus summaries -- this lane's peer state has flaked twice today. CERT CHAIN, unchanged from the G0 work-order: executes-clean -> fresh-Claude Auditor -> certifier_id claude (d6id8o0h) cross-model-certified, decorrelation cross -> Director dual-PASS -> human merge.
